## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-fascicle late-Míng / early-Qīng abridged commentary on the *Sìfēn prātimokṣa* by **Yǒngjué Yuánxián** 永覺元賢 ([元賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E8%B3%A2), 1578–1657), the major Cáodòng 曹洞 Chán master and Vinaya specialist. 約義 *yuēyì* "essential meaning" indicates a condensed exposition.

**Abstract**

Yuánxián's commentary represents the late-Míng Cáodòng-Chán synthesis of meditative practice with Vinaya observance. As a major Cáodòng Chán master, Yuánxián's involvement in Vinaya scholarship reflects the broader late-Míng integration of meditation and discipline pioneered by [祩宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A5%A9%E5%AE%8F) Zhūhóng, [憨山德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%86%A8%E5%B1%B1%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85) Hānshān Déqīng, and [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) Zhìxù. The *Yuēyì* presents the *prātimokṣa* in a condensed form suited to Chán-monastic instruction.
